column4: dialect-gated: all three call testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) directly, with no per-dialect subtest arm, so each skips ONCE (not two, since there is no /mysql or /mssql arm to also count) in a job that supplies no PostgreSQL. Measured on CI run 37933442863, job 113829544899 (`grep '"Action":"skip"' test-report.json | grep -E 'IdxInstancesHeartbeat|IdxInstancesStale|WorkflowInstancesFillfactor'`): exactly these three, each once. They assert `pg_get_indexdef`/`pg_class.reloptions` facts via `::regclass` -- Postgres-specific catalog introspection that has no MySQL equivalent, so a MySQL run cannot exercise them at all (cleat#3272, cleat#3274).

Measured on CI run 37933442863, job 113829544779: exactly these three, each once.
